caseNameFull: Carl S. Reynolds, in Error v. The State of Connecticut
attorneys: Mr. Clayton B. Smith for plaintiff in error. Mr. H. A. Hull for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
In error to the Supreme Court of Errors of the State of Connecticut.

Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Schlosser v. Hemphill, *585198 U. S. 173; California Consolidated Mining Company v. Manley, decided October 22, and cases cited.

Mr. Clayton B. Smith for plaintiff in error. Mr. H. A. Hull for defendant in error.
